full_text:
A wolf, injured by hunting hounds, lay bleeding and helpless in his lair. Seeing a sheep passing outside, he groaned: "Bring me a drink from the cool spring, neighbor, and I will find meat for myself!"

The prudent sheep replied: "If I bring you water to drink, you will make my flesh the meat you speak of!" and galloped on her way.
moral: Never minister to the requests of a predator whose recovery means your slaughter.

Believing rumors and flattery without proof

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
